title: John Hutchison's lab in Vancouver

tellings.quote: which I witnessed when I went over to his home. It was stuffed full of old oscilloscopes

plain: A writer, Nick Cook, says that sometime in the 1990s or 2000s he visited the home of an inventor, John Hutchison, in Vancouver, Canada. Cook says the house was stuffed full of old oscilloscopes, machines that show electrical signals on a screen, which Hutchison used in his experiments. Cook tells it in a talk about antigravity, the idea of machines that cancel out gravity, which would change flight entirely if it worked.
